contradicting_evidence: The latest completed BTC and ETH hourly candles are positive and show substantial taker-buy participation.
The October 1 settled BTC ETF flow is positive at $102.7 million.
Stablecoin supply increases over 1d, 7d and 30d, although deployment remains unconfirmed.
Thirty-day relative alt performance is stronger: 35 of 49 BlockchainCenter constituents outperform BTC. This preserves a recovery alternative but does not confirm current transmission.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: A downside-biased, uneven path is more defensible than sustained upside continuation. Short rebounds may occur without repairing broad participation, leaving renewed weakness tests plausible. This is a low-confidence directional tilt, not a confirmed breakdown or a forecast of pullback depth.
falsification_conditions: A sustained spot-led recovery with improving large/mid-alt participation and rising ETH/BTC would invalidate the downside tilt.
Subsequent supportive ETH ETF flows accompanied by broad market gains would weaken the current flow-divergence argument.
Repeated observations showing price resilience and participation improvement through weakness tests would contradict continuation of the negative cross-section.
missing_evidence: Sequential price and breadth observations distinguishing persistent weakness from a completed pullback.
Later settled ETF sessions, particularly whether ETH outflows persist or reverse.
Evidence that growing stablecoin supply is being deployed into sustained spot demand.
supporting_evidence: The freshest breadth proxy has 25 advancers and 74 decliners; its mean and median 24h returns are approximately -1.62% and -1.54%. These are one evidence family, not independent votes.
Large- and mid-alt proxies show only approximately 5.9% and 16% advancing, with negative median returns. Weakness is not explained solely by an isolated outlier.
The small-alt proxy also has a negative median return and only 27.5% advancing. Relative outperformance against falling BTC is not positive transmission.
The latest settled ETH ETF flow is -$55.4 million, contrasting with positive BTC flows and leaving broad demand confirmation absent.
